title: Prove sharp C tensor prefix scales with integral endpoints (no κ)
body:
## Summary

For `C=[[1+i,1-i],[1-i,1+i]]/2`, prove the exact scale needed to make every axis prefix integral when both the input and complete tensor output are Gaussian integral. Claim type: **scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration**.

```text
j processed axes:    sharp Gaussian exponent min(j,f-j), pi=1+i
all prefixes:        least binary scale 2^ceil(floor(f/2)/2)
arithmetic wrapper:  scale input; apply all C axes; divide completed output
```

The proof uses both integral endpoints. Paired-coordinate inputs attain the bound at every cut, including a middle cut of any fixed axis order. This supplies a sharp arithmetic bridge to #7429's intermediate-integrality precondition. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit CubeJerry #7429 at `1a555e469b89af70d309bc966f8f813ac11dc887` for the literal positive C leaf and its explicit integrality gap; jmbarrancoml #3091 and alejandrozu for the established C tensor, physical axis method and unrestricted reserve; and Clear1nsight #3382 for the different maximal simultaneous exactness lattice. Classical fractional-ideal and tensor methods retain their prior credit. No predecessor scientific verifier is imported or replayed.

Only six new files under `research/native-c-endpoint-prefix-scale/` are added. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19571939).

## Evidence

- **Before:** #7429 explicitly requires integral outputs at every tensor axis; integral final output alone does not meet that precondition.
- **After:** the written all-f proof gives the least common scale, matching inputs and the exact arithmetic scaling/unscaling composition.
- Exact local checks pass 164 sharp cut witnesses through f=10, all 65,808 Gaussian 0/1-component arrays through f=3, 180 separately coded rational-prefix comparisons, direct tensor-entry comparisons through f=4, all 153 axis permutations through f=5, and eight named semantic controls. Exactly 968 enumerated inputs have integral final outputs, and all their 3,792 checked prefixes pass the theorem's bounds.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized CPython 3.12.15 runs pass in about 0.25 seconds each. Both registered commands, metadata/source pins, committed-byte/source-history preflight and a read-only Git-free optimized replay with empty PATH pass locally. Normal, optimized and detached receipts agree at the same package bytes. Receipts are generated from results and file hashes; none is hand-written or committed.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/native-c-endpoint-prefix-scale/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/native-c-endpoint-prefix-scale/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-c-endpoint-prefix-scale
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/native-c-endpoint-prefix-scale --check-source-history
```

Another installed CPython 3.12 path can replace the shown interpreter. Expected markers are `PASS_NATIVE_C_ENDPOINT_PREFIX_SCALE`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The integral final output is a required promise. Signed-range bounds, literal scale/unscale programs, source admission, ownership, movement, scratch and retained-history costs remain open. This proof supplies no complete physical MOVE/caller, paid/productive invoice, selected assumption discharge or complete multiplication theorem. All five framework assumptions remain. Native-machine and selected cold replays, formal-kernel verification and independent human review were not run. Every registered local command passed; no registered local obligation is deferred to CI.

Canonical main was refreshed before submission and remains `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8, selected #7000. Exact-formula, general partial-product, main-tree, merged-PR and live-claim searches found no same-scope result in the inspected coverage. The final overlap refresh reported 767 open PRs and 7,348 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. Unpublished work and arbitrary unsearched diffs remain outside that coverage.

## Open next questions

Install the sharp scale around one literal positive C leaf: supply an actual producer with integral final output, prove sufficient intermediate signed width, and price both exact conversions with movement, owners, scratch and retained history. A favorable complete bill is required before any supplier claim. This contribution stops at the first sharp arithmetic result and reserves no follow-up.

## Related open work

- #7429 implements the same selected positive C tensor. This proves a new arithmetic entrance bridge and does not replay or certify that machine implementation.
- #7430 implements the two binary monomial maps around the same selected MOVE. Their physical composition remains separate from this central-tensor integrality theorem.
- #7426 implements that MOVE's quadratic Gaussian phase. Phase/tensor composition and its complete range and ownership contracts remain unproved here.
- #7462 shortens the same MOVE's left CNOT word. It changes a monomial gate count, while this result changes an arithmetic integrality precondition; no competing numerical quantity is computed.
- #7411 prices a Walsh packing change for a Type B idle. This theorem supplies no Walsh conversion tariff or packing improvement.
- #647 supplies an alternative exact-RAM C-tensor construction. Its computational model and recurrence differ; this result supplies no new runtime or exponent comparison.

The completion refresh inspected the six other open PRs from this account created since the CLAIM, #7462 through #7467. The only same-MOVE contribution is #7462, already listed above. The other scopes concern different matrices, helper-subspace optimization or compiler width; no competing integral-prefix scale or numerical disagreement was identified. No extra mathematical computations were run to compare them.

Hosted package certification remains unavailable pending the repository-level repair. No fix, retrigger commit or job rerun was made. The contribution's head and mathematical scope are unchanged.
